purpose: Final shared WASM regression for the 12 original runtime-enabled devices, after EE panels and Watcher encoder timing integration.
sourceCheckpointNote: c629bc9 was an unpublished integration build checkpoint. Executable and input SHA256 values identify the tested artifacts independently of the later consolidated publication commit.

moduleChecks.archiveHelperScope: ZIP quota limits were changed independently during the batch; this helper was not frozen per process. All selected official archive/member hashes and initial Flash images match the earlier receipt. This is a frozen WASM/worker regression, not acceptance of later loader-cache changes.

byteSource: Previously downloaded original artifacts via a caller-supplied URL map, with local-only enforcement. Ordinary archive/member, firmware, chip and layout checks remained active.
initialStorage: Each run used isolated pristine in-memory Flash and, where declared, a prepared 64 MiB FAT32 card. No user saved data was cleared.
scope: Actual platform loader/runtime/worker/WASM under Node; not browser DOM, WebGL or cross-origin testing.
No physical hardware, optical color calibration, full sensor/audio/camera or cloud certification.
Wall time and scheduling-derived throughput are deliberately omitted; native performance is a separate quiet benchmark.
